name: eel-shock-native
description: Native iOS/Android wrapper for Eel Shock (Capacitor). Wraps the built root index.html in a WebView — does not touch src/**, build.mjs, or the test suite, and is not part of the browser build.

scripts.sync: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync
scripts.open:ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.open:android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
